Method of Attack: Remote code execution via external SQL queries exploiting SQLite vulnerabilities
Impacted Systems: Google Chrome prior to 79.0.3945.79 with WebSQL enabled
Other software using SQLite as a component with external SQL query support
PC/Mobile devices/IoT devices depending on attack surface
Attack Vector: Exploitation of SQLite vulnerabilities through external SQL queries, specifically via WebSQL in browsers
Indicators of Compromise: Google Chrome version 79.0.3945.79 and SQLite patches dated 13 Dec 2019
